name: look-at-bobo
description: Look at Bobo - a first-person game about finding a cat doing cute things. Built in code, deployed as plain static files.

scripts.capture: node tools/capture.mjs tools/testscene.html --times 0,2.4,5 --views overview,contact,first-person --moments default,cardboard-box,keyboard,win --out captures/testscene --selftest
scripts.capture:weak: node tools/capture.mjs tools/testscene.html --times 2.4 --views overview --moments default --out captures/testscene-weaklaptop --gpu swiftshader --selftest
scripts.capture:planted: node tools/capture.mjs tools/testscene.html --times 2.4 --views overview,contact --moments default,cardboard-box --out captures/testscene-planted --param plant=lift --selftest
scripts.capture:patriot: node tools/capture.mjs design/style-test.html --times 0,2.4 --views diorama,cats-close,bobo-face --moments patriot-bobo --out captures/patriot-bobo --selftest
scripts.capture:demo: node tools/capture.mjs demo/talking-demo.html --times 0,1.2,2.4 --views diorama,first-person,bobo-face,decoy-face --moments idle,catch,wrong,win --out captures/talking-demo --selftest --param gate=off --param score=7
scripts.capture:demo:determinism: node tools/capture.mjs demo/talking-demo.html --times 1.2 --views diorama,first-person --moments idle,catch,wrong,win --out captures/talking-demo-determinism --determinism --param gate=off --param score=7
scripts.capture:demo:planted: node tools/capture.mjs demo/talking-demo.html --times 1.2 --views first-person --moments catch,wrong,win --out captures/talking-demo-planted --selftest --param gate=off --param plant=text
scripts.capture:slice: node tools/capture.mjs game/slice.html --times 0,1.2,2.4 --views all --moments all --out captures/slice --selftest --param gate=off --param score=2
scripts.capture:slice:determinism: node tools/capture.mjs game/slice.html --times 1.2 --views first-person,diorama --moments loaf-couch,catch,wrong,win --out captures/slice-determinism --determinism --param gate=off --param score=2
scripts.capture:slice:planted: node tools/capture.mjs game/slice.html --times 1.2 --views first-person --moments win --out captures/slice-planted --selftest --param gate=off --param plant=text
scripts.capture:slice:weak: node tools/capture.mjs game/slice.html --times 1.2 --views diorama --moments catch,win --out captures/slice-weak --gpu swiftshader --selftest --param gate=off
scripts.capture:full: node tools/capture.mjs game/full.html --times 0,1.2,2.4 --views all --moments all --out captures/full --selftest --param gate=off --param score=2
scripts.capture:full:spots: node tools/capture.mjs game/full.html --times 1.2 --views diorama --moments couch-loaf.sofa-back,window-bird.e-window,window-bird.balcony-door,window-bird.balcony-rail,couch-loaf.balcony-chair,sink-sit.counter-return,sink-sit.fridge,sink-sit.bar,hall-chase.kitchen,hall-chase.hall-door,hall-chase.entry,hall-chase.entry-door,hall-chase.bath-mat,hall-chase.vanity,desk-pen.desk-end,bed-stretch.bed-foot,blanket-biscuits.wardrobe,laundry-nap.nightstand --out captures/full-spots --selftest --param gate=off --param score=2
scripts.capture:full:determinism: node tools/capture.mjs game/full.html --times 1.2 --views first-person,diorama --moments box-sit,catch,wrong,win --out captures/full-determinism --determinism --param gate=off --param score=2
scripts.capture:full:planted: node tools/capture.mjs game/full.html --times 1.2 --views first-person --moments win --out captures/full-planted --selftest --param gate=off --param plant=text
scripts.capture:full:weak: node tools/capture.mjs game/full.html --times 1.2 --views diorama --moments catch,win --out captures/full-weak --gpu swiftshader --selftest --param gate=off
scripts.capture:full:patriot: node tools/capture.mjs game/full.html --times 1.2 --views diorama --moments couch-loaf.couch,window-bird.balcony-rail,sink-sit.sink,hall-chase.hall,desk-pen.desk,hall-chase.bath-mat --out captures/full-patriot --selftest --param gate=off --param patriot=on
